1 رَضَحَ , aor.
رَضَحَ , (L, Msb, K,) inf. n. رَضْحٌ, (S, L, Msb,) He broke, (S, L, Msb, K,) and bruised, brayed, or crushed, (Msb, TA,) pebbles, (S, K,) or date-stones, (S, L, Msb, K,) &c., (Msb,) with a stone [&c.]; (L;) like رَضَخَ, (S, Msb,) which is a dial. var. (Msb.) And He broke, (Msb, TA,) or bruised, (TA,) a person's head (Msb, TA) with a stone; (TA;) as also رَضَخَ. (Msb, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
